The '''DL-7H heavy blaster pistol''' was a medium-ranged model of [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]] made by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]],<ref name="DC" /> and sold for 850 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The pistol was extremely powerful and drew heavily from its [[Power cell/Legends|power pack]], which gave it enough power to punch through laminated [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. The heavy draw drained the pak quickly however, and also meant the weapon lacked a stun setting. This earned it a deserved reputation as being deadly, and the weapons were outlawed or restricted even on some [[Planet/Legends|planets]] that normally only had very lax weaponry laws. DL-7Hs were favored by large numbers of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="DC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The DL-7H was first shown in ''[[Dangerous Covenants]]'' a sourcebook released in [[2014]] for the ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying game produced by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].
